install_notes.detail: python3 on PATH is 3.9.6, below the 3.10 requirement. Homebrew Python 3.13.7 is installed and is the interpreter FIXR uses.
pipx 1.7.1. It does not have cambot-cli installed.
esptool.py 4.12.0 is inside the ESP-IDF Python 3.9 environment at ~/.espressif. It is not on the default PATH. PlatformIO Core 6.1.18 is also installed.

ESP-IDF v5.5.6 is at ~/esp/esp-idf. The plan says ESP-IDF 5.x and does not pin a release, so this is the current 5.x bugfix. install.sh selected Python 3.9.6 because that is python3 on PATH. cmake 4.4.5 and ninja 1.13.2 were missing and were installed with Homebrew. firmware/ built cambot_bringup.bin for esp32s3, 16 MB flash, octal PSRAM.
The cambot CLI is not installed. It ships with firmware milestone M2, which is not in this repository. Do not invent cambot commands.
TTL port /dev/cu.usbserial-11230. esptool identified ESP32-S3 revision v0.2, embedded 8 MB PSRAM, MAC 1c:29:04:31:0d:98.
Flashed the setup test at 115200 on /dev/cu.usbserial-11230. Boot log: boot=HELLO cambot fw=setup id=cambot-0d98, flash_mb=16, psram_mb=8, camera=ok pid=0x3660.
Joined Figaro as WPA3-SAE. Two earlier attempts logged wifi=disconnected reason=2 and reason=204, then wifi=ip=192.168.68.51. RSSI was about -26.

POST /api/register returned register=ok id=cambot-0d98. The registrar at 192.168.68.91:8765 listed that camera and fetched a 8947-byte JPEG from GET /api/v1/frame.jpg. The page refreshes the view every two seconds.

fixr/registrar/serve.py --check registered a local client, listed it, and served the page. Frame fetch returned 503 because CAMBOT_CAMERA_PASSWORD was not set. A camera on the LAN still cannot register until firmware sends POST /api/register.
